an10.12:1.1: “Bhikkhus, in this teaching and training a bhikkhu who has given up five factors and possesses five factors is called consummate, accomplished, a supreme person.
an10.12:1.2: And how has a bhikkhu given up five factors?
an10.12:1.3: It’s when a bhikkhu has given up sensual desire, ill will, dullness and drowsiness, restlessness and remorse, and doubt.
an10.12:1.4: That’s how a bhikkhu has given up five factors.
an10.12:2.1: And how does a bhikkhu have five factors?
an10.12:2.2: It’s when a bhikkhu has the entire spectrum of an adept’s ethics, concentration, wisdom, freedom, and knowledge and vision of freedom.
an10.12:2.3: That’s how a bhikkhu has five factors.
an10.12:3.1: In this teaching and training a bhikkhu who has given up five factors and possesses five factors is called consummate, accomplished, a supreme person.
an10.12:4.4: are not found in a bhikkhu at all.
